$comment: OpenWA OCI Infra — A2A-reachable OpenCode agent for ai4xedu/openwa-oci-infra.
This gives the co-resident OpenCode instance a real A2A server, so peers
(Hermes/omnizya-agent, Claude, a2abridge) can PUSH tasks to it instead of
only pulling. Port 4096 is the OpenCode server this wrapper drives.

agentCard.name: OpenWA OCI Infra Agent
agentCard.description: OpenCode agent scoped to the ai4xedu/openwa-oci-infra repository (WaaSel / OpenWA on OCI). Plans and implements Linux-operator infrastructure work: OCI Terraform/OpenTofu, Supabase migrations, Docker Compose stack, DNS, and the hexagonal SaaS BFF.

skills.name: Infrastructure Planning
skills.description: Plan infrastructure changes for the OCI/Supabase/Docker stack without applying them

skills.name: Repo Maintenance
skills.description: Edit scripts, workflows and docs in the openwa-oci-infra repository

skills.name: Architecture Design
skills.description: Design the hexagonal BFF and multi-tenant tenancy model for the SaaS gateway
